_comment: Bundled browser libraries: npm package, version and npm integrity of the tarball they were taken from. ci/vendored-js.py checks these versions against OSV.

jtable.note: the code inside says 2.5.0; npm 2.6.0 is the last release (2018), unmaintained
patches: jquery.jtable.min.js: removed the window 'unload' handler (Chrome blocks unload: console error; the handler only reset a flag)

themes: only metro/blue and the shared metro icons; @font-face rules removed from blue/jtable.min.css (they loaded Open Sans from themes.googleusercontent.com, a dead URL that also leaked the visitor's IP to Google)
js/jtable-fixes.js (outside vendor/) overrides row removal, see the comment there
